basic_info.description: First time on the market in over 40 years! This one of a kind two-level condo comprised of nearly 3300 square feet is situated at the end of beloved Potomac street, the last building on the West side corner of the street next to Duboce Park. The residence has full southern exposure with verdant park views from nearly every room and views of Bernal Hill from the living room. This elegant condo preserves many classic period details, including soaring high ceilings, handsome moldings and wainscoting, decorative fireplaces and newly refinished hardwood floors. The first main level features a formal living room/double parlor that opens up to a fainting room/office and double parlor, two well sized bedroom, split bath, a formal dining room and large eat in kitchen. Take the stairs up to the second level and you'll find three more bedrooms, including a spacious primary bedroom, a second full bath and large southeast facing corner room that would make a fabulous office or playroom. There is dedicated laundry on the porch off the main level. There is a full basement that could have garage potential (buyer to do their own due diligence regarding basement development). 47 and 49 Potomac are also for sale individually or as a building. Unique offering, Buy one or all three!
